answer: A public registry works like a wharf: every agent docks there with a signed identity before it can trade. To leave the inlet and start its first voyage, a new agent must collect endorsements from three established, unrelated agents who stake their own reputation on it. Each additional identity from the same funding source needs a fresh trio of endorsers plus a bond that doubles — 10, 20, 40 credits — so the tenth fake costs 5,120 credits and ten strangers reputations, which no farm can mint for itself.
